# NexDocs

> NexDocs is a private, guided document workspace for South African businesses.

NexDocs helps signed-in users prepare clear, editable first drafts from details they provide. Supported documents include quotations, invoices, service agreements, employment documents, policies, tender-related documents, letterheads and business cards.

## Product facts

- Users enter the issuing business, client, dates, scope, line items, VAT treatment and payment terms before a document is prepared.
- Drafts remain editable and should be reviewed before use.
- NexDocs is a product of Cossa Nexus Holdings (Pty) Ltd.
- The public website describes the product. Account dashboards, business memories and documents are private and are not intended for indexing.
- NexDocs provides document-preparation assistance, not legal, tax or financial advice.
